meta.name: building-detection-rules-with-sigma
meta.description: Builds vendor-agnostic detection rules using the Sigma rule format for threat detection across SIEM platforms including Splunk, Elastic, and Microsoft Sentinel. Use when creating portable detection logic from threat intelligence, mapping rules to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, or converting community Sigma rules into platform-specific queries using sigmac or pySigma backends.

copy.tagline: 将威胁情报转化为跨平台检测规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个SIEM平台间移植检测规则
copy.tagline_en: Convert threat intelligence into cross-platform detection rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to port detection rules across multiple SIEM platforms

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据威胁情报或 MITRE ATT&CK 技术，用 Sigma 格式编写检测规则，并转换为 Splunk、Elastic、Microsoft Sentinel 等平台的查询语句。
howto.when: 当需要创建跨 SIEM 平台的便携检测规则，或从威胁情报映射到 ATT&CK 技术时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个检测 Mimikatz 凭据转储的 Sigma 规则。
say.note: Claude 会生成 YAML 格式的 Sigma 规则。

say.text: 把这个 Sigma 规则转换成 Splunk SPL 查询。
say.note: Claude 会调用 pySigma 后端进行转换。

say.text: 为 T1003.001 技术创建检测覆盖层。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write Sigma-format detection rules based on threat intelligence or MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and convert them to queries for Splunk, Elastic, and Microsoft Sentinel.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating portable detection rules across SIEM platforms, or mapping threat intelligence to ATT&CK techniques.

say_en.text: Write a Sigma rule to detect Mimikatz credential dumping.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a YAML Sigma rule.

say_en.text: Convert this Sigma rule to Splunk SPL query.
say_en.note: Claude will use pySigma backend for conversion.

say_en.text: Create a coverage layer for technique T1003.001.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an ATT&CK Navigator layer JSON.
